WITH z_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.abhvreg,
    CASE 
      WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) = 0 OR STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ROUND(CAST((ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) AS numeric), 4)
    END AS new_peercorr
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
)
SELECT abhvreg, new_peercorr FROM z_scores LIMIT 10;

WITH z_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.abhvreg,
    CASE 
      WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) = 0 OR STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ROUND(CAST((ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) AS numeric), 4)
    END AS new_peercorr
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
)
UPDATE advancedbehavior ab
SET peercorr = zs.new_peercorr
FROM z_scores zs
WHERE ab.abhvreg = zs.abhvreg
RETURNING ab.abhvreg, ab.peercorr;
